title: Splitting 96 Well Plates for gDNA Extraction and Continuing Culture
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x78frrw
materials: Tap to lift cells from plate.

steps.title: Coat 96 Well Plate
steps.instruction: Coat the 96 well plate with Matrigel and incubate.

steps.title: Prepare Plate for Expansion
steps.instruction: Prepare the plate by removing the coating and adding growth medium.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL mTesR1 supplemented with 10 uM Rock Inhibitor to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Detach Cells
steps.instruction: Wash and trypsinize the cells to detach them from the plate.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 200 µL PBS and aspirate.
Check under microscope to ensure cells have detached from the plate.

steps.title: Neutralize and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Stop trypsinization and distribute cells between plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL FBS and tap to mix.
Transfer 50 µL to a 96 well PCR plate, maintaining the location of each sample for gDNA extraction.
Transfer the remaining cells (~30 uL) to a 96 well plate containing mTesR1.

steps.title: Incubate and Maintain Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells and perform regular media maintenance.

substeps.instruction: After 24 hours, perform daily media changes with mTesR1.
